description: Scroll viewport or active element smoothly by deltaX and deltaY pixels. Supports inline post-scroll waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText and includeSnapshot.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

includeSnapshot.description: Capture and return an interactive page snapshot after scrolling (default: false)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after scrolling

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after scrolling

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after scrolling

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after scrolling
